messages.content: Use only the supplied source. Return exactly two labeled lines: Opening: <date> and Volunteers: <meeting day and time>. Do not add other facts or Markdown.

Create a second analysis focused only on the opening date and volunteer schedule. Source follows:


Project Cedar is a fictional community library used for acceptance testing.
The library opens on 22 November 2026.
Jonah Patel coordinates the library.
The library has nine reading tables.
Volunteers meet every Tuesday at 18:15.
The book return is beside the north entrance.
